digest.component_or_area: CLI help system and route registry
propositions: Pure-intercept routes lack committed help artifacts and are absent from overview help discovery despite being accessible via pure-intercept routing
Identity and config child parsers disable their own help actions, causing `--help` to reach top-level usage and exit with error instead of returning child usage
Generator help-backing predicate and help-discovery census across four sites must use exact predicate `not route.hidden and not route.retired` without adding route metadata
CLI help generation must apply usage unwrapping and metavar normalization consistently across both public help entry points to produce identical committed bytes across Python versions

Top-level help overview must include every live visible route outside the documented omit set (`help`, `bridge-fsck`, `bridge-probe`) exactly once, with `_NESTED_INTERCEPTS` limited to `audit`, `config`, `identity`, `llm`, `prompt`, `criteria`, `workflow`
